name: Artificer
tools: one type of artisan’s tools of your choice
equipment: (a) studded leather armor or (b) scale mail
thieves’ tools and a dungeoneer’s pack

actions.name: Flash of Genius
actions.desc: Reaction: a creature within 30 ft adds your INT modifier to an ability check or saving throw

1.name: Magical Tinkering
1.desc: With thieves' or artisan's tools, touch a Tiny object (action) to give it a small magic trait: light, a recorded message, a smell or sound, or a still image. INT mod objects at once.

1.name: Spellcasting
1.desc: Prepared INT caster working through tools or infused items as the focus; can cast rituals it has prepared.

2.name: Infuse Item
2.desc: After a long rest, turn ordinary objects into magic items with the infusions you know (Infused Items column caps how many at once).

3.name: The Right Tool for the Job
3.desc: 1 hour with tools in hand (can be during a rest): create one set of nonmagical artisan's tools.

6.name: Tool Expertise
6.desc: Double proficiency bonus on ability checks made with tools you are proficient in.

7.name: Flash of Genius
7.desc: Reaction: you or a creature within 30 ft adds your INT mod to a check or save; INT mod uses per long rest.

10.name: Magic Item Adept
10.desc: Attune to 4 items; common and uncommon items take a quarter of the time and half the gold to craft.

11.name: Spell-Storing Item
11.desc: After a long rest store a 1st or 2nd level, 1-action artificer spell in a weapon or focus; the holder casts it with your modifier, 2x INT mod times.

14.name: Magic Item Savant
14.desc: Attune to 5 items; ignore class, race, spell and level requirements of magic items.

20.name: Soul of Artifice
20.desc: +1 to all saves per attuned item; dropping to 0 HP, end an infusion (reaction) to stay at 1 HP.

3.name: Tool Proficiency
3.desc: Proficiency with alchemist's supplies (or another artisan's tool if you have it).

3.name: Alchemist Spells
3.desc: Subclass spells always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells.

3.name: Experimental Elixir
3.desc: After a long rest make a random elixir (healing, swiftness, resilience, boldness, flight or transformation); more for a spell slot each, effect chosen. More free ones at 6th and 15th.

5.name: Alchemical Savant
5.desc: Spells cast through alchemist's supplies add INT mod to one healing roll or acid, fire, necrotic or poison damage roll.

9.name: Restorative Reagents
9.desc: Elixirs also give 2d6 + INT temp HP; Lesser Restoration without a slot INT mod times per long rest.

15.name: Chemical Mastery
15.desc: Resist acid and poison, immune to poisoned; Greater Restoration and Heal once each per long rest without a slot or components.

3.name: Tools of the Trade
3.desc: Proficiency with heavy armor and smith's tools.

3.name: Armorer Spells
3.desc: Subclass spells always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells.

3.name: Arcane Armor
3.desc: Action with smith's tools: your armor becomes Arcane Armor, no STR requirement, works as a focus, can't be removed against your will.

3.name: Armor Model
3.desc: Guardian (thunder gauntlets 1d8, foes hit have disadvantage against others; Defensive Field temp HP) or Infiltrator (lightning launcher 1d6 ranged, +1d6 once per turn; faster and stealthier). Uses INT; swap on a rest.

5.name: Extra Attack
5.desc: Attack twice with the Attack action.

9.name: Armor Modifications
9.desc: The armor counts as four items for infusions (chest, boots, helmet, weapon); +2 infused items, only on the armor.

15.name: Perfected Armor
15.desc: Guardian: reaction pulls a creature 25 ft (STR save vs spell DC), then a melee attack, PB times per long rest. Infiltrator: lightning hits make the target glimmer, next attack against it has advantage and +1d6 lightning.

3.name: Tool Proficiency
3.desc: Proficiency with woodcarver's tools (or another artisan's tool if you have it).

3.name: Artillerist Spells
3.desc: Subclass spells always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells.

3.name: Eldritch Cannon
3.desc: Action: create a cannon (AC 18, 5x level HP) once per long rest or for a slot; bonus action to fire: Flamethrower 2d8 fire cone, Force Ballista 2d8 force ranged, or Protector 1d8 + INT temp HP nearby.

5.name: Arcane Firearm
5.desc: Carve a wand, staff or rod into a firearm focus: artificer spells through it add 1d8 to one damage roll.

9.name: Explosive Cannon
9.desc: Cannon damage +1d8; action to detonate it: 3d8 force within 20 ft, DEX save for half.

15.name: Fortified Position
15.desc: Half cover within 10 ft of your cannon; two cannons at once, fired with one bonus action.

3.name: Tool Proficiency
3.desc: Proficiency with smith's tools (or another artisan's tool if you have it).

3.name: Battle Smith Spells
3.desc: Subclass spells always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells.

3.name: Battle Ready
3.desc: Proficiency with martial weapons; magic weapons can use INT for attack and damage.

3.name: Steel Defender
3.desc: A construct companion that acts after you: it Dodges unless you command it with a bonus action (Force-Empowered Rend, or Repair); reaction imposes disadvantage on an attack near it.

5.name: Extra Attack
5.desc: Attack twice with the Attack action.

9.name: Arcane Jolt
9.desc: Once per turn when you or the defender hit with a magic weapon: +2d6 force, or heal 2d6 to a creature within 30 ft; INT mod times per long rest.

15.name: Improved Defender
15.desc: Arcane Jolt becomes 4d6; defender +2 AC and its Deflect Attack deals 1d4 + INT force to the attacker.
